Package gui

Class BaseTerminalController

java.lang.Object
gui.BaseTerminalController
Direct Known Subclasses:
CancelRegistrationController, GetTableController, JoinWaitlistController, PayBillController
public abstract class BaseTerminalController extends Object
Abstract base class for all terminal-related GUI controllers in the BistroNine application. Provides common functionality for scene switching, client management, and user session state.
